Only corrected_v7 contains final endpoint-guard measurements; earlier phases are historical pre-correction observations.

phases.v3: Pre-fusion grouped measurements; temporal drift confounded scalar versus SIMD comparison.
phases.v4: Fused affine SIMD; balanced 24x8 pairs. Zig AUTO policy decision not yet applied.
phases.v5: Historical Zig explicit SIMD/scalar policy and pre-proof-boundary immutable CLI measurements; before endpoint correction.
phases.v6: Historical prepared Rust sampler/proof boundary: four Rust paired cases and 32 immutable CLI cases accepted as UNBASELINED; before endpoint correction.
phases.v7: Final exact endpoint guard: all 8 Zig pairs, 4 Rust pairs and 32 immutable CLI cases retained in corrected_v7, together with the post-correction Kani rerun.

earlier_invalid_run.reason: Combined Zig/Rust build-mode identity did not match probes. Rejected before v3; excluded from conclusions; complete raw records retained in external history.
